source: 用户记录表.xlsx > 样本条件（中英） sheet（枪战类长线新手体验研究）
note: 该workbook的"经验认知乐趣对比""玩家行为&乐趣整理"等sheet里出现的 G1/G2/G3 组别代号，其定义写在同workbook的另一个sheet"样本条件（中英）"里，而不是和访谈内容放在一起，所以单独抽出来存成这个查询用的小文件，靠 group 代号做关联，不重复塞进每条segment里。

overall_demographics.ethnicity_zh: 符合美国社会人口构成 (白种人 : 其他 = 7 : 3)
overall_demographics.ethnicity_en: In accordance with the demographic makeup of American society. (Caucasian : Others = 7 : 3)
overall_demographics.gender_age_zh: 可接受性别分布：男>女；18~40岁均匀分布；
overall_demographics.gender_age_en: Male >= Female is acceptable; 18~40 years old evenly distributed;

criteria.tarkov_experience_zh: 从未有玩过《逃离塔科夫》、《猎杀对决》、《暗区突围PC版》、《萤火突击PC版》、《The Cycle》、《Marauders》（记录玩家对《逃离塔科夫》的认知，"这是一款什么样的游戏？"）
criteria.tarkov_experience_en: Don't have prior experience playing games such as "Escape from Tarkov," "Hunter Showdown," "Dark Zone Breakout PC Version," "Firefly Assault PC Version," "The Cycle," or "Marauders." (Recording players' perceptions of Escape from Tarkov, "What kind of game is this?")
criteria.pc_shooter_experience_zh: 《使命召唤：现代战争III》游戏时长>200h（键鼠优先，记录玩家在战争地带中DMZ模式的游戏经验）
criteria.pc_shooter_experience_en: "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III" active player, game time >200h (keyboard and mouse priority, recording the player's gaming experience in DMZ mode in Warzone)
criteria.mobile_shooter_experience_zh: 其中，必须有2人为《使命召唤手游》/《PUBGM》活跃玩家，近两赛季段位≥Pro或Platinum，本赛季游戏场次＞50
criteria.mobile_shooter_experience_en: Among them, 2 must be active players of "Call of Duty Mobile"/"PUBGM", with a rank of >= Pro or Platinum in the past two seasons, and more than 50 matches played this season.

criteria.tarkov_experience_zh: 近1年内开始游玩《逃离塔科夫》，经历删档次数≤1，累计在线时间100-500h（记录玩家品类竞品经验《使命召唤DMZ》、《猎杀对决》、《暗区突围PC版》、《萤火突击PC版》、《The Cycle》、《Marauders》）
criteria.tarkov_experience_en: Started playing "Escape from Tarkov" within 1 year, wipe <= 1, and online time between 100-500 hours (recording players' experience in competing products in categories such as "Call of Duty DMZ", "Hunt: Showdown", "Arena Breakout: Infinite", "Lost Light PC Version", "The Cycle", "Marauders")
criteria.pc_experience_zh: 记录玩家PC/Console射击游戏经验（要求玩家分别列举3款自己最常玩的FPS游戏和3款自己最常玩的RPG游戏，并说明原因）
criteria.pc_experience_en: Record player PC/Console shooting game experience (players are required to list the 3 most played FPS games and 3 most played RPG games respectively, and explain the reasons)
criteria.mobile_experience_zh: 记录玩家手游射击游戏经验（重点记录：《使命召唤手游》、《PUBGM》、《暗区突围》、《萤火突击》）
criteria.mobile_experience_en: Record players' experience in mobile shooting games (key records: "Call of Duty Mobile", "PUBGM", "Arena Breakout", "Lost Light")

criteria.tarkov_experience_zh: 持续游玩《逃离塔科夫》3年以上，经历删档次数≥3，累计在线时间＞700h（记录玩家品类竞品经验《使命召唤DMZ》、《猎杀对决》、《暗区突围PC版》、《萤火突击PC版》、《The Cycle》、《Marauders》）
criteria.tarkov_experience_en: Continuously playing "Escape from Tarkov" for more than 3 years, wipe >= 3, online time > 700 hours (recording players' experience in competing products in categories such as "Call of Duty DMZ", "Hunt: Showdown", "Arena Breakout: Infinite", "Lost Light PC Version", "The Cycle", "Marauders")
criteria.pc_experience_zh: 记录玩家PC/Console射击游戏经验（要求玩家分别列举3款自己最常玩的FPS游戏和3款自己最常玩的RPG游戏，并说明原因）
criteria.pc_experience_en: Record player PC/Console shooting game experience (players are required to list the 3 most played FPS games and 3 most played RPG games respectively, and explain the reasons)
criteria.mobile_experience_note: 原表格中 G3 这一项没有单独写手游经验标准（只到"端游经验"为止），不是遗漏抄录，是原始sheet本身没有这一行，如需要应向负责抽样的同事确认。

open_questions: "用户列表"sheet里还有一份用不同编码（G3-P1/G1-P2风格，英文姓名，Ethnicity列出现Cauc/Hisp/AA等）的受访者名单，人口学要求（白种人:其他=7:3）明显是面向美国受访者的，和"玩家行为&乐趣整理"里P1-P15这批数据的对应关系还没确认，不要假设两者可以直接关联。
